messages:
emily: Heads-up — multiple customers (CorpA, CorpB) reporting repeated re-auths after the edge proxy change this morning. Sessions aren't sticky; they get logged out right after a redirect.

sam: I see 401s in the auth logs from edge-proxy-5 around 09:12 UTC, same stacktrace each time.

emily: Both affected customers use SSO (OIDC & SAML) + MFA. They click an external link and come back and get kicked to re-login.

jia: Any cookie details yet? domain/samesite/secure differences? :thinking:

emily: Pasting sanitized headers we captured from CorpA repro session:
```
GET /docs/guide HTTP/1.1
Host: docs.corpA.app
Cookie: session_token=eyJ...; other_pref=1

SET-Cookie: session_token=abc123; Domain=app.corpA; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax
```

sam: Aha — Domain on Set-Cookie is `app.corpA` but requests are proxied through `edge.redwood.ai` and host rewritten to `app.corpA`. If proxy rewrites or strips Host/Origin, browser behaviour on cross-site navigation could drop the cookie.

mike: Reproduced locally: user clicks external link, browser does cross-site navigation back to edge origin, cookie not sent on the subsequent request -> auth server treats as new session -> triggers reauth.

emily: Repro steps for engineering:
1) Sign into CorpA workspace in Incognito.
2) Click external link to docs (open new tab).
3) Click link back to the app which routes via edge.redwood.ai proxy.
4) Observe redirect to /auth/relogin and missing session cookie on request to /validate.

sam: quick debug command I used:
```bash
curl -v \ 
  -H "Host: app.corpA" \ 
  -b "session_token=abc123" \ 
  "https://edge.redwood.ai/validate"
```
Log output shows no cookie forwarded at the proxy layer for cross-site navigations.

jia: Potential causes: proxy config dropping cookie headers on 307/302 redirects, SameSite behaviour after cross-site nav (Lax blocks POST & some redirects), or Domain mismatch because proxy adds subdomain.

mike: Mitigation options:
- Set SameSite=None; Secure on session cookies so cross-site navigations include them.
- Use a cookie Domain that covers both hostnames (e.g., `.corpA`).
- Update edge proxy to preserve Host and not rewrite cookie domains.

emily: Customer wants a quick workaround we can recommend while we fix infra. Which is least invasive?

sam: Short-term: recommend setting SameSite=None and Secure + domain `.corpA` for cookies. That should reduce drops for cross-site navs. Long-term: change proxy to avoid host rewriting and ensure Set-Cookie passthrough.

mike: I'll open a PR with a comment describing risk and a canary for edge-proxy to preserve `Set-Cookie` and host header.

support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-9872 linking this thread and customer logs.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy of edge-proxy-preserve-cookie started to `us-west` at 2024-06-18T10:21:00Z.

mike: Canary looks good, no increased 5xxs. Testing with CorpA repro flow shows cookies preserved and session validated.

emily: Pushed the short-term config change to CorpA (SameSite=None, Domain=.corpA). Customer confirmed less frequent reauths.

jia: We'll schedule a follow-up to fully revert host rewriting in the next sprints and add automated regression tests for cross-site cookie behaviour.

emily: Thanks all — marking this as monitored on the ticket. Will close once two business days with no reauth reports from both customers. :thumbsup:

sam: Nice work. If anyone needs logs or a replay session I can share screen later today.

mike: Adding checklist to PR for ops: update cookie flags, proxy preserve-host, add e2e for external-link flow.

emily: Closing loop for now. Will update SUP-9872 with timeline and remediation notes.
